B0.calibration_role: none; exact support and frozen gate need no calibration

E.estimand: probability that a registered policy disagrees with exhaustive on final valid decision, best valid candidate, or failure status under complete cost accounting

E.failure_semantics: decision/candidate mismatch, hidden or unbilled cost, budget breach, missing trace, or fidelity instability counts adverse
